convert_script = '''
from docx import Document
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import getSampleStyleSheet, ParagraphStyle
from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, Table, TableStyle
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER, TA_LEFT
import os

doc = Document("docs/customer_report.docx")

# Collect paragraphs and tables in order
paragraphs = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    paragraphs.append({"text": para.text, "style": para.style.name})

tables_data = []
for table in doc.tables:
    tdata = []
    for row in table.rows:
        tdata.append([cell.text for cell in row.cells])
    tables_data.append(tdata)

# Build PDF
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
pdf_path = "output/customer_report.pdf"
pdf_doc = SimpleDocTemplate(pdf_path, pagesize=letter,
                            topMargin=0.75*inch, bottomMargin=0.75*inch,
                            leftMargin=0.75*inch, rightMargin=0.75*inch)

styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name='DocTitle', parent=styles['Title'], fontSize=16, spaceAfter=12, alignment=TA_CENTER))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name='DocHeading', parent=styles['Heading2'], fontSize=13, spaceAfter=8, spaceBefore=12))
styles.add(ParagraphStyle(name='DocBody', parent=styles['Normal'], fontSize=10, spaceAfter=6, leading=14))

story = []
table_idx = 0

for p in paragraphs:
    text = p["text"].strip()
    sname = p["style"]

    if not text:
        story.append(Spacer(1, 6))
        continue

    if sname in ("Title",):
        story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocTitle"]))
    elif sname in ("Heading 1", "Heading 2", "Heading 3", "Heading1", "Heading2", "Heading3"):
        story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocHeading"]))
    else:
        story.append(Paragraph(text, styles["DocBody"]))

# Add tables
for tdata in tables_data:
    story.append(Spacer(1, 10))
    t = Table(tdata, repeatRows=1)
    t.setStyle(TableStyle([
        ('BACKGROUND', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.HexColor('#4472C4')),
        ('TEXTCOLOR', (0, 0), (-1, 0), colors.white),
        ('FONTNAME', (0, 0), (-1, 0), 'Helvetica-Bold'),
        ('FONTSIZE', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 9),
        ('ALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'LEFT'),
        ('GRID', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 0.5, colors.grey),
        ('ROWBACKGROUNDS', (0, 1), (-1, -1), [colors.whitesmoke, colors.white]),
        ('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
        ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 4),
    ]))
    story.append(t)

pdf_doc.build(story)
print(f"PDF created at {pdf_path}")
print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize(pdf_path)} bytes")
'''
await write_file("./convert_docx_to_pdf.py", convert_script)
print("written")

script_content = '''import fitz
from docx import Document

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

# Collect all elements in document order
elements = []
for child in doc.element.body:
    tag = child.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in child.tag else child.tag
    if tag == "p":
        for p in doc.paragraphs:
            if p._element is child:
                elements.append(("para", p.text.strip(), p.style.name))
                break
    elif tag == "tbl":
        pass  # we'll handle tables separately

# Collect tables
tables = []
for table in doc.tables:
    tdata = []
    for row in table.rows:
        tdata.append([cell.text for cell in row.cells])
    tables.append(tdata)

# Find where tables appear relative to paragraphs
all_elements = []
tbl_idx = 0
for child in doc.element.body:
    tag = child.tag.split("}")[-1] if "}" in child.tag else child.tag
    if tag == "p":
        for p in doc.paragraphs:
            if p._element is child:
                all_elements.append(("para", p.text.strip(), p.style.name))
                break
    elif tag == "tbl":
        if tbl_idx < len(tables):
            all_elements.append(("table", tables[tbl_idx], None))
            tbl_idx += 1

# Create PDF with fitz
pdf = fitz.open()
page = pdf.new_page(width=612, height=792)  # Letter size
y = 50  # starting y position
margin_left = 50
margin_right = 562
page_width = margin_right - margin_left

def new_page_if_needed(y_pos, needed=30):
    nonlocal page
    if y_pos + needed > 750:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=612, height=792)
        return 50
    return y_pos

for etype, content, sname in all_elements:
    if etype == "para":
        text = content
        if not text:
            y += 8
            continue

        if sname == "Title":
            y = new_page_if_needed(y, 30)
            fontsize = 18
            fontname = "helv"
            tw = fitz.get_text_length(text, fontname=fontname, fontsize=fontsize)
            x = margin_left + (page_width - tw) / 2
            if x < margin_left:
                x = margin_left
            page.insert_text(fitz.Point(x, y), text, fontname=fontname, fontsize=fontsize, color=(0.1, 0.1, 0.4))
            y += 28
        elif "Heading" in (sname or ""):
            y = new_page_if_needed(y, 25)
            y += 8
            page.insert_text(fitz.Point(margin_left, y), text, fontname="helv", fontsize=13, color=(0.15, 0.15, 0.5))
            y += 22
        else:
            y = new_page_if_needed(y, 18)
            # Word wrap for long lines
            words = text.split()
            line = ""
            fontsize = 10
            fontname = "helv"
            for word in words:
                test = line + (" " if line else "") + word
                tw = fitz.get_text_length(test, fontname=fontname, fontsize=fontsize)
                if tw > page_width and line:
                    page.insert_text(fitz.Point(margin_left, y), line, fontname=fontname, fontsize=fontsize)
                    y += 14
                    y = new_page_if_needed(y, 14)
                    line = word
                else:
                    line = test
            if line:
                page.insert_text(fitz.Point(margin_left, y), line, fontname=fontname, fontsize=fontsize)
                y += 14

    elif etype == "table":
        tdata = content
        if not tdata:
            continue
        y += 10
        num_cols = len(tdata[0])
        col_width = page_width / num_cols

        for row_idx, row in enumerate(tdata):
            y = new_page_if_needed(y, 20)
            for col_idx, cell_text in enumerate(row):
                x = margin_left + col_idx * col_width
                # Header row styling
                if row_idx == 0:
                    rect = fitz.Rect(x, y - 12, x + col_width, y + 4)
                    page.draw_rect(rect, color=(0.27, 0.45, 0.77), fill=(0.27, 0.45, 0.77))
                    page.insert_text(fitz.Point(x + 4, y), cell_text, fontname="helv", fontsize=9, color=(1, 1, 1))
                else:
                    if row_idx % 2 == 0:
                        rect = fitz.Rect(x, y - 12, x + col_width, y + 4)
                        page.draw_rect(rect, color=None, fill=(0.95, 0.95, 0.95))
                    page.insert_text(fitz.Point(x + 4, y), cell_text, fontname="helv", fontsize=9)
                # Draw cell border
                rect = fitz.Rect(x, y - 12, x + col_width, y + 4)
                page.draw_rect(rect, color=(0.7, 0.7, 0.7))
            y += 18
        y += 8

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully at /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
await write_file("./convert_to_pdf.py", script_content)
print("Script written")

convert_result = await run_command("python ./convert_to_pdf.py")
